text:
anna (DevEx PM): Quick sync — I dropped the Q3 DevEx roadmap draft in the drive. We only have bandwidth for 3 big items + 1 quick win. Can we align on priorities before Friday?

mike (SDK Eng): +1. My top asks: TypeScript SDK ergonomics (promise-based streaming), Python streaming SDK, and stable retry/backoff API.

rita (Docs): From docs POV I want to reserve time for migration guides and interactive quickstart notebooks. If TS changes a lot we need a migration doc.

eva (Solutions Eng): Customers keep asking for sample apps that show: long-running chat, multi-model routing, and embeddings + vector DB workflow. Template apps would cut onboarding time.

chris (Platform): Platform dependency: streaming needs work on connection pooling and KV cache headers. We can allocate 2 sprints but it blocks other infra work.

anna (DevEx PM): So likely tradeoffs: pick either both SDK streaming items (TS + Py) or TS + sample apps. Which has higher impact?

mike (SDK Eng): Impact: streaming Py unlocks a lot of ML teams (low friction). TS ergonomics improves PLG metrics (decrease time-to-first-call). If we can only do 1, TS first.

tom (Eng Lead): Engineering capacity: implementing streaming for both langs in parallel is risky. We can do TS streaming + single-language reference for Python (docs + example).

rita (Docs): That would be fine — we can ship a Python quickstart that uses the new TS/HTTP streaming endpoints with a small shim and call it out as reference.

eva (Solutions Eng): For sample apps: propose a lightweight "playbook" approach — 3 focused templates (chat, embeddings+search, tool-calling) with README, tests, and deploy script. Each template target: ~1 week to build.

anna (DevEx PM): Draft prioritization vote — please react with :one:, :two:, :three:
- Option 1 (mike): TS streaming + sample playbook set + migration docs
- Option 2 (tom): TS streaming + Python reference + quickstart improvements
- Option 3 (chris): Python streaming + sample playbooks + infra polish

mike (SDK Eng): :one:  (leaning Product/PLG)

eva (Solutions Eng): :two:  (we need Py reference in deals)

rita (Docs): :one:  (docs impact least if TS first)

chris (Platform): :three:  (platform risk)

anna (DevEx PM): Looks like Option 1 wins by product votes. Next: scope negotiation. We must define launch criteria before dev starts. Proposed launch criteria: 
- Shipping: public SDK release (TS v2) + 3 sample playbooks in repo + migration guide.
- Quality: e2e tests for each playbook, <50 open SDK bugs, >=90% CI pass for SDKs.
- Adoption: 500 quickstart completions or 50 dev signups using sample kits within 30 days.

tom (Eng Lead): Add performance SLOs: median SDK call latency within 1.5x of current endpoint; streaming memory <200MB for 10k token sessions.

rita (Docs): Add docs metrics: average quickstart completion time <15min and feedback NPS >= +30 on the sample app survey.

mike (SDK Eng): Implementation note: TS streaming will change public APIs (breaking). We need a deprecation window in NPM and a migration path in examples. semver major.

anna (DevEx PM): Ok — plan for:
- Week 1–2: finalize API spec + design review
- Week 3–6: implementation (TS streaming + sample playbooks)
- Week 7: docs + migration guides + e2e tests
- Week 8: internal dogfood + launch checklist

build-bot: CI status — branch devex/feature/ts-streaming: 12/14 checks passing, failing on "streaming-integration-test".

eva (Solutions Eng): For scope negotiation: if streaming integration tests take longer, drop one playbook (keep chat + embeddings) and push tool-calling to next quarter.

anna (DevEx PM): Decision: proceed with Option 1 but reduce playbooks to 2 (chat, embeddings). Keep tool-calling as stretch. I'll update the roadmap doc and OKRs: target metric is 500 quickstart completions and migration guide published.

mike (SDK Eng): I'll post API RFC by EOD and call out breaking changes.

rita (Docs): I'll draft the migration guide template and notebook quickstart.

chris (Platform): I'll prioritize streaming infra ticket and try to unblock the integration test.

anna (DevEx PM): Thanks. I'll schedule the follow-up sync Fri 10:00am. If anyone wants to contest the scope, DM me before noon Thurs.

build-bot: New comment on devex/feature/ts-streaming: streaming-integration-test failed due to timeout (kafka connector).

mike (SDK Eng): noted — pulling platform async
